reason: README runs a random agent on a StarCraft II map via python -m pysc2.bin.agent; the free Linux headless SC2 binary and maps download publicly (EULA password only), CPU-only.
demo: README 'Run an agent': python -m pysc2.bin.agent --map CollectMineralShards (with mini_games maps)
goal: Install pysc2, download the Linux StarCraft II headless build (Blizzard s2client-proto downloads, ~4GB, extract to ~/StarCraftII or set SC2PATH) and the mini_games maps (pysc2 v1.2 release mini_games.zip) into the SC2 Maps dir. Then run `python -m pysc2.bin.agent --map CollectMineralShards --norender --max_episodes 1 --max_agent_steps 200` so the random agent plays and finishes without error, and make env.sh export SC2PATH if non-default.
